attributes.action: Fair Five-Year ILR Routes for All Skilled Workers
attributes.additional_details: Professionals in engineering, science, IT, construction and business contribute to Britain's economy through their skills, expertise, hard work and taxes. Many have invested years in education, secured specialist jobs by meeting strict qualification, salary and sponsorship requirements, and relied on the 5-year ILR route. We seek fair transitional protection. We respect healthcare workers and their exemptions, but all legitimate Skilled Workers deserve equal recognition, regardless of sector.
attributes.background: Protect the five-year ILR route for existing eligible Skilled Worker visa holders and ensure fair settlement opportunities for skilled professionals across all sectors.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Protect the five-year ILR route for existing Skilled Workers" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785621
